description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing application state related to gym management features such as memberships, classes, bookings, payments, profile, and dashboard data. It includes methods for loading data from external APIs and manages loading state.

methods.name: loadDashboard
methods.description: Loads dashboard data, either mock or real based on environment variable.

methods.name: loadMemberships
methods.description: Fetches memberships data from external API and updates the store.

methods.name: loadClasses
methods.description: Fetches classes data from external API and updates the store.

methods.name: loadBookings
methods.description: Fetches bookings data from external API and updates the store.

methods.name: loadPayments
methods.description: Fetches payments data from external API and updates the store.

methods.name: loadProfile
methods.description: Fetches user profile data from external API and updates the store.
